dedupe_keys.name: supporting data for a low cost open source monitoring system for collecting high resolution water use data on magnetically driven residential water meters

description: Supporting data for "A low-cost, open source monitoring system for collecting high-resolution water use data on magnetically-driven residential water meters is a data set deposited in CUAHSI by its authors Camilo J. Bastidas Pacheco, Jeffery S. Horsburgh (Utah State University). The files provided here are the supporting data and code files for the analyses presented in "A low-cost, open source monitoring system for collecting high-resolution water use data on magnetically-driven residential water meters," an article in Sensors (https://doi.org/10.3390/s20133655). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. Formats: Excel, CSV. Size stated: 108846140 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is This resource is shared under the Creative Commons Attribution CC BY.. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
